gen-righteous-gf-stack-sans-text: Stack Sans Text draws a marker-like line with big-bodied lowercase, friendly and modern. Righteous sits above in full-lipped display letters that look like bent steel rod, and bumping the plain sans up a size would suit it.
gen-tourney-gf-tiktok-sans: Tourney stretches its bulky, evenly cut letters out wide, bold and athletic from the first word. TikTok Sans follows with a lowercase that rises nearly to cap height, so a slightly modest size still reads easily.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-savate: Savate reads contemporary and clean, its curves open-jawed and its hairlines sturdier than you would expect from a plain sans. Metamorphous above it adds roomy sidebearings and a soft fat-to-slim stroke.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-shanti: Tight, confident, and built like a wall of type. Oswald packs its rows closely, while Shanti's generous entry into the e makes a long passage feel open and easy going.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-ruda: Ascenders that barely clear the x-height give Love Ya Like A Sister its squat, expressive stance. Ruda follows with a wire-like monoline and wide-mouthed rounds, so a long stretch on screen goes down smoothly.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-takri: Eater turns dark and aggressive, with wide gaps between letters and stems that ebb and flow in weight. Noto Sans Takri is the sturdy partner.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Stubby, pencil-thick, and a bit mischievous. Flavors does its best work with compass-drawn diagonals and towering lowercase, and Noto Sans Tai Viet answers by being approachable, with terminals pulled back from its curves as a plain sans.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Noto Sans Ugaritic keeps almost no gap between x-height and cap height, and its open mouths look like unjoined chalk arcs. Autour One carries the same small step from capital to lowercase, in strokes like pressed twine.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-zanab: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of flat weight, expressive and commanding without any swelling. And Noto Sans Zanabazar Square, with its soaring x-height and wide gaps, keeps a long passage crisp and approachable.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-pathway-extreme: Commanding up top, Goldman spreads wide with round forms like open parentheses. Pathway Extreme, a plain sans, keeps its rounded letters clearly open and its ascenders stubby, so a long passage stays modern and clean.
